selection.selection_purpose: One fixed archive cell for a worked example, not a representative statistical sample.

level_of_input: NOAA Level II processed equivalent reflectivity, not receiver voltages

assumption.reference: Fulton et al. (1998), page 382, tropical relationship
assumption.status: Chosen illustrative conversion for actual reflectivity. Not independently validated for this cell and not the official NOAA rain estimate.

processing: No averaging or gap filling. Decode one REF gate, convert dBZ to linear reflectivity, then apply the selected Z-R relation.
original_use: NOAA public data. Derived extract and calculations by Klimatologie.eu, not official NOAA products.
